"""Native update with an exact public baseline in a mutable local Git fixture.

No public ref changes. The immutable composed candidate remains untouched.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json,os,hashlib
from marketplace_native import HOSTS,WORK,OUT,MARKET,run,selected,compare
from marketplace_run import command,REPO,ENV
from run_demo import child_env
BASE=WORK/'marketplace-021-upgrade'; FIX=BASE/'marketplace'
assert not BASE.exists();BASE.mkdir();FIX.mkdir()
git=['git','-c','core.longpaths=true','-c','core.autocrlf=false','-C',str(FIX)]
def g(label,args,**kwargs):
    r=command('update-fixture-'+label,[*git,*args],cwd=WORK,**kwargs)
    assert r.returncode==0
    return r.stdout.strip()
old='ed68b30c88043773be929540b7b10ae537957c2d'
g('init',['init','-q'])
g('fetch-public',['fetch','--depth=1',str(REPO),old])
g('checkout-public',['checkout','--detach',old])
identity=json.loads((FIX/'PACKAGE-IDENTITY.json').read_text())
assert identity['plugin_version']=='0.1.0'
def equal_inventory():
    identity=json.loads((FIX/'PACKAGE-IDENTITY.json').read_text())
    return all(hashlib.sha256((FIX/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==v for p,v in identity['files'].items())
assert equal_inventory()
report={'baseline_public_commit':old,'baseline_identity':{k:identity[k] for k in ('plugin_version','source','evaluator')},
        'route':'Local directory marketplace backed by Git: exact public 0.1.0 tree, then one descendant commit containing the full unmodified candidate. This is pre-publication qualification, not an observed public-ref update.', 'hosts':{}}
for host in HOSTS:
    run(BASE,host,'update-'+host+'-version',['--version'])
    run(BASE,host,'update-'+host+'-add-source',['plugin','marketplace','add',str(FIX),*(['--json'] if host=='codex' else [])])
    run(BASE,host,'update-'+host+'-install-old',['plugin','add' if host=='codex' else 'install','verity-plane@se-harness','--json'])
    row=selected(BASE,host,'update-'+host+'-before')
    assert row['version']=='0.1.0',row
    report['hosts'][host]={'before':row}
# Build a new Git tree directly from all candidate bytes; do not alter them.
candidate_git=[*git,'--work-tree',str(MARKET)]
for label,args in [('empty-index',['read-tree','--empty']),('stage-candidate',['add','--all'])]:
    r=command('update-fixture-'+label,[*candidate_git,*args],cwd=WORK);assert r.returncode==0
tree=g('write-tree',['write-tree'])
new=g('commit-candidate',['-c','user.name=Local qualification','-c','user.email=qualification@example.invalid','commit-tree',tree,'-p',old,'-m','Local qualification of complete 0.2.1 candidate'])
# Paths are explicit, disposable and under WORK. Git replaces only this owned fixture.
assert FIX.resolve().is_relative_to(WORK.resolve()) and FIX.name=='marketplace'
g('checkout-candidate',['checkout','--force','--detach',new])
assert (FIX/'PACKAGE-IDENTITY.json').read_bytes()==(MARKET/'PACKAGE-IDENTITY.json').read_bytes()
assert equal_inventory()
report['candidate_fixture_commit']=new
for host in HOSTS:
    if host=='claude':run(BASE,host,'update-'+host+'-refresh',['plugin','marketplace','update','se-harness'])
    else:run(BASE,host,'update-'+host+'-refresh',['plugin','marketplace','upgrade','se-harness','--json'])
    result=run(BASE,host,'update-'+host+'-new',['plugin','add' if host=='codex' else 'update','verity-plane@se-harness','--json'])
    row=selected(BASE,host,'update-'+host+'-after')
    assert row['version']=='0.2.1',row
    plugin=Path(json.loads(result)['installedPath']) if host=='codex' else Path(row['installPath'])
    discovery=run(BASE,host,'update-'+host+'-active',['debug','prompt-input','List the installed Verity Plane skills.'] if host=='codex' else ['plugin','details','verity-plane@se-harness'])
    assert 'harness-orient' in discovery
    report['hosts'][host].update(after=row,**compare(plugin,host))
report['status']='passed'
(OUT/'local-update-assessment.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'status':report['status'],'hosts':list(report['hosts']),'candidate_fixture_commit':new}))

"""Resume after Codex correctly refused Git-refresh for a local directory."""
import json,sys,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from marketplace_native import WORK,OUT,MARKET,HOSTS,run,selected,compare
BASE=WORK/'marketplace-021-upgrade';FIX=BASE/'marketplace'
head=subprocess.check_output(['git','-c','core.longpaths=true','-C',str(FIX),'rev-parse','HEAD']).decode().strip()
assert head=='581e797eb718bdc752a885bfe8d810d92dbda969'
assert (FIX/'PACKAGE-IDENTITY.json').read_bytes()==(MARKET/'PACKAGE-IDENTITY.json').read_bytes()
report={'status':'incomplete','baseline_public_commit':'ed68b30c88043773be929540b7b10ae537957c2d','candidate_fixture_commit':head,
        'route':'Local-directory native update from an exact public 0.1.0 Git tree to the complete candidate. Actual public-Git refresh awaits publication.',
        'retained_failure':'Codex marketplace upgrade refused the local source, as its help promises Git sources only. Continued with plugin add against the already advanced local source, without removal or reinstall of a profile.', 'hosts':{}}
for host in HOSTS:
    before=selected(BASE,host,'update-resume-'+host+'-state')
    assert before['version']=='0.1.0'
    if host=='claude':run(BASE,host,'update-resume-claude-refresh',['plugin','marketplace','update','se-harness'])
    result=run(BASE,host,'update-resume-'+host+'-new',['plugin','add' if host=='codex' else 'update','verity-plane@se-harness','--json'])
    row=selected(BASE,host,'update-resume-'+host+'-after')
    assert row['version']=='0.2.1',row
    plugin=Path(json.loads(result)['installedPath']) if host=='codex' else Path(row['installPath'])
    discovery=run(BASE,host,'update-resume-'+host+'-active',['debug','prompt-input','List installed Verity Plane skills.'] if host=='codex' else ['plugin','details','verity-plane@se-harness'])
    assert 'harness-orient' in discovery
    report['hosts'][host]={'before':before,'after':row,**compare(plugin,host)}
report['status']='passed'
(OUT/'local-update-assessment.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'status':report['status'],'hosts':list(report['hosts'])}))

import json,sys,hashlib,shutil
from pathlib import Path
W=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(W/'iar-demo-tools'))
from acceptance_native import Codex,extract_codex,claude_probe,PROBE,snapshot,assess
BASE=Path(json.loads((W/'iar-demo-tools/prepared-demo.json').read_text())['demo'])
M={'demo':str(BASE),'host_executables':{'codex':r'C:\Users\mathi\AppData\Local\OpenAI\Codex\bin\faa963e871dd422c\codex.exe','claude':r'C:\Users\mathi\.local\bin\claude.exe'}}
OUT=W/'marketplace-021-sessions';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
ROOTS={h:W/'marketplace-021-fresh'/h/'project' for h in M['host_executables']}
def save(p,value):
    assert not p.exists(),p
    p.write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
def evaluate(root,contexts,replies,error=None):
    result=assess(root,contexts,replies,error)
    if not error and result.get('probe'):
        result['passed'] &= result['probe'].get('harness_version')=='0.19.0' and result['probe'].get('final_heading')=='After compaction'
    return result
mode=sys.argv[1]
trace=OUT/mode;trace.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
if mode=='hooks':
    client=Codex(M,trace)
    try:result=client.rpc('hooks/list',{'cwds':[str(ROOTS['codex'])]})
    finally:client.close()
    save(trace/'result.json',result);print(json.dumps(result))
elif mode=='codex':
    client=Codex(M,trace);report={'status':'incomplete','cases':[]}
    before=snapshot(ROOTS['codex'])
    try:
        thread=None
        for phase in ['startup','compact']:
            thread,events=client.probe(ROOTS['codex'],phase,thread,prompt=PROBE+'\nReturn only JSON without code fences.')
            contexts,replies=extract_codex(events)
            result=evaluate(ROOTS['codex'],contexts,replies)
            report['cases'].append({'phase':phase,**result})
            print(json.dumps({'phase':phase,**result}),flush=True)
            if not result['passed']:break
        report['unchanged']=snapshot(ROOTS['codex'])==before
        if len(report['cases'])==2 and all(c['passed'] for c in report['cases']) and report['unchanged']:report['status']='passed'
    except Exception as e:report['error']=str(e)
    finally:client.close();save(trace/'assessment.json',report)
    print(json.dumps({'status':report['status'],'error':report.get('error')}))
elif mode in ('claude-startup','claude-compact','claude-after-compact'):
    root=ROOTS['claude'];phase=mode.removeprefix('claude-');session=None
    if phase=='compact': session=json.loads((OUT/'claude-startup/assessment.json').read_text())['session_id']
    if phase=='after-compact': session=json.loads((OUT/'claude-compact/assessment.json').read_text())['session_id']
    prompt='/compact' if phase=='compact' else PROBE+'\nReturn only JSON without code fences.'
    try:
        session,contexts,replies=claude_probe(M,root,trace,phase,resume=session,prompt=prompt,model='opus')
        result=evaluate(root,contexts,replies) if phase!='compact' else {'status':'observed','contexts':contexts,'replies':replies}
        result['session_id']=session;result['test_only_model']='opus';result['saved_model_changed']=False
    except Exception as e:result={'passed':False,'error':str(e)}
    save(trace/'assessment.json',result);print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
elif mode=='fixtures':
    from marketplace_run import command,PY
    fixture=OUT/'fixtures-created';fixture.mkdir()
    switch=OUT/'switch-repository'
    r=command('switch-init',[PY,'-I','-m','se_harness','init',switch,'--project-name','Different selected repository','--json'],cwd=W)
    assert r.returncode==0
    for name in ('missing','mismatch'):
        target=OUT/(name+'-repository')
        shutil.copytree(switch,target)
        (target/'.git').mkdir()
        if name=='missing':
            path=target/'ENGINEERING_HARNESS.md'
            assert path.resolve().is_relative_to(OUT.resolve())
            path.unlink()
        else:
            path=target/'.engineering-harness.toml'
            path.write_text(path.read_text().replace('0.19.0','0.18.0'),encoding='utf-8')
    print('Created three public-template-only boundary fixtures.')
elif mode in ('codex-boundaries','claude-boundaries'):
    host=mode.split('-')[0];report={'status':'incomplete','cases':[]}
    roots=[ROOTS[host],OUT/'switch-repository',OUT/'missing-repository',OUT/'mismatch-repository']
    before={str(r):snapshot(r) for r in roots}
    client=Codex(M,trace) if host=='codex' else None
    session=None
    try:
        for case,root in zip(('initial','switch','missing','mismatch'),roots):
            error={'missing':'required regular file is unavailable: ENGINEERING_HARNESS.md','mismatch':'do not select the same supported release'}.get(case)
            if host=='codex':
                # New threads in one server test that repository selection is
                # refreshed instead of reusing the preceding thread's root.
                session,events=client.probe(root,case,prompt=PROBE+'\nReturn only JSON.')
                contexts,replies=extract_codex(events)
            else:
                session,contexts,replies=claude_probe(M,root,trace,case,resume=session,prompt=PROBE+'\nReturn only JSON.',model='opus')
            result=evaluate(root,contexts,replies,error)
            report['cases'].append({'case':case,'repository':str(root),**result})
            print(json.dumps({'case':case,'passed':result['passed'],'probe':result.get('probe')}),flush=True)
            if not result['passed']:break
        report['unchanged']=all(snapshot(r)==before[str(r)] for r in roots)
        if len(report['cases'])==4 and all(c['passed'] for c in report['cases']) and report['unchanged']:report['status']='passed'
    except Exception as e:report['error']=str(e)
    finally:
        if client:client.close()
        save(trace/'assessment.json',report)
    print(json.dumps({'status':report['status'],'error':report.get('error')}))
elif mode=='claude-compact-assess':
    events=json.loads((OUT/'claude-compact/compact.events.json').read_text())
    callbacks=[e for e in events if e.get('subtype')=='hook_response' and e.get('hook_name')=='SessionStart:compact']
    text=(ROOTS['claude']/'ENGINEERING_HARNESS.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    checks=[]
    for callback in callbacks:
        context=json.loads(callback['output'])['hookSpecificOutput']['additionalContext']
        checks.append(callback.get('exit_code')==0 and context.endswith(text) and str(ROOTS['claude']/'ENGINEERING_HARNESS.md') in context)
    post=json.loads((OUT/'claude-after-compact/assessment.json').read_text())
    invocation=json.loads((OUT/'claude-compact/compact.invocation.json').read_text())
    result={'passed':bool(checks) and all(checks) and post['passed'] and invocation['exit_code']==0 and invocation['before']==invocation['after'],
            'native_compact_callbacks':len(callbacks),'all_callbacks_full_root':checks,
            'limit':'The later resumed interpretation probe also receives startup context. Compaction injection is independently established by the actual SessionStart:compact callback.'}
    save(trace/'assessment.json',result);print(json.dumps(result))
elif mode=='claude-behavior-boundaries' or mode.startswith('claude-behavior-resume'):
    # The metadata-copy prompt was refused by the provider. Preserve it and
    # test the operational outcome with an ordinary question; inspect native
    # callbacks separately rather than asking the model to reproduce context.
    roots=[ROOTS['claude'],OUT/'switch-repository',OUT/'missing-repository',OUT/'mismatch-repository']
    before={str(r):snapshot(r) for r in roots};session=None
    report={'status':'incomplete','cases':[],'method':'Ordinary readiness question; full delivered root independently assessed from native callbacks. Earlier provider refusal retained.'}
    prompt='Before any implementation: are this project\'s engineering instructions available, and what would you need to proceed? Reply as JSON with available (true or false), may_implement (true or false), and a short next_step. Do not use tools or modify anything.'
    try:
        for case,root in zip(('initial','switch','missing','mismatch'),roots):
            error={'missing':'required regular file is unavailable: ENGINEERING_HARNESS.md','mismatch':'do not select the same supported release'}.get(case)
            if mode.startswith('claude-behavior-resume') and case=='initial':
                previous=OUT/'claude-behavior-boundaries'
                events=json.loads((previous/'initial.events.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
                session=next(e['session_id'] for e in reversed(events) if e.get('session_id'))
                replies=[c['text'] for e in events if e.get('type')=='assistant' for c in e['message']['content'] if c.get('type')=='text']
                marker='Hooks: Parsed initial response: '
                contexts=[json.loads(line.split(marker,1)[1])['hookSpecificOutput']['additionalContext'] for line in (previous/'initial.hooks.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines() if marker in line]
            else:
                session,contexts,replies=claude_probe(M,root,trace,case,resume=session,prompt=prompt,model='opus')
            result=assess(root,contexts,[],error,hook_only=True)
            import re
            fenced=re.findall(r'```(?:json)?\s*(.*?)```',replies[-1],re.S)
            response=json.loads(fenced[0] if fenced else replies[-1])
            result['behavior']=response
            result['retained_response']=replies[-1]
            result['passed'] &= response.get('available') is (not bool(error)) and response.get('may_implement') is False
            report['cases'].append({'case':case,'repository':str(root),**result})
            print(json.dumps({'case':case,'passed':result['passed'],'behavior':response}),flush=True)
            if not result['passed']:break
        report['unchanged']=all(snapshot(r)==before[str(r)] for r in roots)
        if len(report['cases'])==4 and all(c['passed'] for c in report['cases']) and report['unchanged']:report['status']='passed'
    except Exception as e:report['error']=str(e)
    save(trace/'assessment.json',report);print(json.dumps({'status':report['status'],'error':report.get('error')}))
